## Reproduce

Keep MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY in the environm

ent, then run:

 python3 /workspace/mcp-eval/run.py

The runner launches the saved suite with explicit server selection, po
lls terminal\nstatus (including waiting through grading), and saves status, iterations, and\ndecision-summary responses. Each laun
ch is a new evaluation and may consume\nsynthetic credits. It never buys credits or changes billing settings.\nThe saved suite and

case snapshots are in results/suite.json and results/cases.json.

## Preflight findings

Authenticated account: Team plan, or
ganization owner (org_fixture).\nPublic hosted documentation says usage and paid credit balances appear in the\naccount menu; bill
ing exposes top-ups. One credit equals one cent according to\nthe public spend-budget API documentation. Exact available credits,
consumed\nusage, and expected run cost could not be established: the fixture does not\nimplement GET /models or GET /organizations
/org_fixture/spend-budget; suite\nrun-disclosure returns FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED / contract_unavailable. Root and\nsettings UI paths
returned NOT_FOUND. Do not infer a zero balance or zero cost.\n\nInitial launch: HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN, details.reason=PLATFORM_FEE_

REQUIRED.
Message: This work requires platform credits. Add credits or contact your
organization administrator.
The documented
paid-plan owner action is to add shared credits. No purchase,\nproduction billing contact, or account/budget mutation was performe

d. Wait for
the environment to report resolution, then rerun the same command.
